title: Software Engineer 2 (Frontend)
description:
Position : Software Engineer II, Frontend 
 Base Location : New Delhi, India (Remote / Hybrid) 
 Experience : 4+ years 
 About the Engineering Team 
 Cheggs engineering team is a community of passionate builders who partner closely with 
 product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to shape the future of online learning. 
 Grounded in Cheggs core valuesputting students first, acting with integrity, and holding 
 a high bar for excellencewe build with care and accountability. As the world and our 
 industry continue to evolve, we stay true to those principles: we invest in quality, design for 
 scale and longevity, and avoid shortcuts (hello unit tests and documentation) so we can deliver 
 reliable, high-impact experiences on time. 
 About the Role 
 We're hiring a Software Engineer II, Frontend to own the design, quality, and delivery of features 
 across our student-facing web applications. This role is focused on building React/Next.js 
 product experiences, the GraphQL-powered data layers behind them, and increasingly, 
 AI-powered study features (step-by-step solutions, Q&A, and personalized study assistance). 
 You will also contribute across the stack as needed this is a frontend-first role with full-stack 
 reach, and you should be comfortable enough with backend concepts and AWS infrastructure to 
 ramp into our Java or Python backend services when a task calls for it. 
 What You'll Do 
 Own frontend features end-to-end architecture, implementation, testing, staged 
 rollout, and production monitoring across student-facing web application. 
 Translate product requirements into component architecture, GraphQL query/schema 
 boundaries, and client-state contracts (React Query, Redux Toolkit, or similar) that other 
 engineers build on. 
 Debug cross-system issues that surface in the UI GraphQL supergraph errors, 
 auth/session edge cases, server/client rendering mismatches by tracing root cause 
 across the stack. 
 Build AI-powered study features responsibly: validate model output (e.g., step-by-step 
 solutions, Q&A answers) before it reaches the UI, design graceful fallbacks for unusable 
 or low-confidence responses, and instrument these flows with telemetry. 
 
 
 
 Apply security and data-protection practices input validation, secure auth/session 
 handling, careful treatment of student data as a default part of the code you ship, not 
 a step someone else checks for. 
 Optimize application performance (rendering strategy, bundle size, Core Web Vitals) as 
 an ongoing part of feature work, particularly for high-traffic student study flows. 
 Own the quality of your changes through automated tests (unit, component, and 
 end-to-end), CI stability, and production validation. 
 Partner closely with Product, Design, and Backend to deliver and harden high-impact 
 student workflows (search, Q&A, subscription/paywall flows, study tools). 
 Contribute to engineering quality through strong code reviews including review of 
 AI-generated code reusable patterns, shared components, and clear documentation 
 that keeps technical debt low. 
 Ship end-to-end changes across the web application and its supporting APIs/schema, as 
 needed. 
 Required Qualifications 
 Most qualified candidates will likely bring 4+ years of professional frontend engineering 
 experience building production web applications, with demonstrated ownership of 
 features from design through launch. 
 Strong hands-on experience with React and Next.js, and comfort working in TypeScript. 
 Working knowledge of web fundamentals common security pitfalls (XSS, CSRF, 
 auth/session handling), performance (rendering strategy, bundle size, Core Web Vitals), 
 and accessibility (WCAG/ARIA basics) and the judgment to apply them without being 
 told to. 
 Experience designing and consuming APIs across common paradigms GraphQL 
 (schema design, codegen, querying), REST, and real-time protocols such as 
 WebSockets and working with at least one modern client-state approach (React 
 Query, Redux Toolkit, or similar). 
 Strong testing and release-validation discipline unit/component testing (Vitest or Jest, 
 React Testing Library) and end-to-end testing (Playwright or Cypress). 
 Comfort using AI-assisted development tools responsibly, with the ability to explain, 
 validate, and safely ship the code you produce. 
 Sound understanding of data structures, algorithms, and general software design 
 principles, applied pragmatically rather than academically. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 
 
 
 Working knowledge of AWS infrastructure concepts (compute, storage, networking, 
 basic service architecture) and some Node.js backend exposure enough of a 
 foundation to ramp into our Java or Python backend services when needed. 
 Experience with Auth0 or similar authentication providers in a Next.js application. 
 Experience shipping AI-powered UI streaming responses, structured output 
 rendering, graceful handling of model failures. Experience contributing to shared 
 component libraries or tooling used across multiple teams/repos. 
 Familiarity with frontend observability tooling (New Relic or similar). 
 Experience in EdTech, e-commerce, or another high-traffic, subscription-based 
 consumer product company. 
 Tech Stack 
 Frontend: React (18/19), Next.js, TypeScript, GraphQL (Apollo tooling, codegen against 
 a shared supergraph), React Query / Redux Toolkit / Zustand, styled-components, MUI 
 Backend (foundational): Node.js, AWS (compute/storage/networking basics) 
 enough to ramp into Kotlin/Java (Spring) or Python (FastAPI/Django) services owned by 
 backend engineering 
 Testing: Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright 
 Auth / Delivery: Auth0, GitLab CI 
 Observability: New Relic 
 AI / ML: OpenAI, RAG, MCP, AWS Bedrock (via shared backend integrations)

Key Skills: Graphql,AWS,Node.js,Software engineering,React.js,Generation,Front end,Nextjs
